svg.text: Four modes of training / evaluation — each orchestrates the sim stack differently

g.text: RL, SDG, and Eval all orchestrate the same logical sim stack (Policy Server → Embodiment Adapter → Robot Controller → Simulator).
The semantic metadata gaps (ActionSemantics, ObsSemantics, EmbodimentMapping) affect all three modes — fixing them once benefits the entire workflow.

Fine-Tuning: pipeline (no live env). RL: closed loop (reward drives weight updates each step). SDG: batch orchestration (env randomization, no weight updates). Eval: read-only (no weight updates, measures performance).
Deployment: RL often fuses optimizer + policy + sim into one GPU process (vectorized envs). Fine-tuning, SDG, and Eval typically use separate processes.
Inputs: Dataset (IL), BaseModel (IL+RL), Reward Function (RL), Env Assets + TaskSpec (SDG+Eval), Checkpoint (Eval), BenchmarkSpec (Eval)
Outputs: Checkpoint with ActionSemantics + ObsSemantics (IL+RL), Episodes with ActionSemantics + ObsSemantics (SDG), EvalResults (Eval)
